decisions.reason: As a dedicated and core laboratory material tied to the firm's established dental workflow offering, it still benefits from sunk development and channel commitment, though after several years weak results would be harder to excuse as temporary.

This lower-visibility accessory has the weakest public commitment and strategic centrality, so by 2022 management can more readily release resources from it despite some reluctance to reverse an earlier launch.
The product's standalone visibility and close connection to digital dental workflows make it strategically important enough that management would continue to justify staying the course.
A custom earmold line fits the firm's core custom manufacturing capabilities and hearing-care channels, so accumulated investment and organizational commitment still favor retention.
